name: The Search Continues
label: Quest
description: The Search Continues: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You thoroughly search this cluster of Murloc hovels, and find no trace of the Menethil Statuette.
Perhaps one of the two nearby hovels to the north and northeast will have more clues.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This barrel is largely untouched. Prying it open...
...you are assaulted by the pungent odor of cheese. It's a little wet, but still tasty!
